LanguageData.ExSymbiotes.MetalhorrorReasonInteraction: {INFECTED_nameDef}'s metalhorror emerged because it was discovered by {0} during a social interaction.
LanguageData.ExSymbiotes.MetalhorrorNoticedDetailsApp:
Metalhorrors are parasites that control the host and use them to infect others.

Metalhorrors grow stronger inside the host as time passes. A metalhorror will cut its way out of the host's body if it knows it's been detected. The process is horrifying, but the host generally survives.

The only way to confirm a person is infected with a metalhorror is to study the metalhorror's fleshy leavings to identify its biosignature, then use the surgical inspection operation with a trusted doctor.

Once discovered, you can use the surgical inspection operation to cause a metalhorror to emerge from its host. Be prepared for a fight.
LanguageData.ExSymbiotes.InteractionDetectedDesc: {0} noticed something wrong with {INFECTED_nameDef} while chatting. {INFECTED_nameDef} exhibited some combination of unnatural behavior, strange vocal sounds, or barely visible metallic worms in the eyes. {0} suspects that {INFECTED_nameDef} is infected with a metalhorror.

LanguageData.ExSymbiotes.NameSymbioteMessageBad: {0}'s symbiote is demanding to have a name. What should your symbiote be called?
LanguageData.ExSymbiotes.SymbioticResurrectionDesc: The symbiote inside will try to resurrect its dead host at the cost of it own life. Succes chance depends on the bond with the host.

LanguageData.ExSymbiotes.SymbioticResurrectionTextSuc: {0} successfully resurrected {1}, {0} was lost in the process.
